title: PF2e / SF2e Odds Calculator
summary: A probability calculator for Pathfinder 2e and Starfinder 2e skill challenges, with full degree-of-success maths.
tagline: See the odds behind a multi-roll skill challenge.
description: Enter a task DC, skill modifier and required successes to calculate per-roll outcomes, projected rolls, and the probability of completing a Pathfinder 2e or Starfinder 2e skill challenge.

features.title: Degree-of-success odds
features.description: Calculate critical success, success, failure and critical failure probabilities, including natural 1 and natural 20 shifts.

features.title: Challenge fulfilment
features.description: Calculate the chance of completing the challenge before a critical failure ends it.

features.title: Projected rolls
features.description: Estimate how many rolls the challenge will take, with critical successes counting twice.

features.title: Pathfinder and Starfinder views
features.description: Switch between presentations for the two game systems.

features.title: Immediate recalculation
features.description: Update the assessment whenever an input changes.

origin.title: Multiple rolls make the odds hard to see.
origin.body: I built this because probability across several events is not obvious, including to the people at my table. A 2e skill challenge combines degrees of success, critical successes that count twice, and the possibility of a critical failure ending the attempt. The calculator turns a DC, skill bonus and required successes into per-roll odds, projected rolls, and the chance of fulfilment or breach. In June 2026 I added Pathfinder and Starfinder themes and presented the results as an assessment by Veliantrix, a contract devil who audits the odds.
